Card Q&A.a:
This card is treated as a card with the same card number as [P-058 Gammamon].This is a special rule, not an effect. Therefore, this text applies when the card is in your hand, breeding area, or any other area. In addition, you can only include up to 4 copies of this card and/or [P-058 Gammamon] when building a deck.
